name: Saikai ~Sotsugyou Ryokou '98~
source:
School life is over and classmates go on a graduation trip for four days to Okakura pension house What kind of memories will the hero build over this trip?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
校园生活结束后，同学们前往冈仓旅馆，进行4天毕业旅行。主人公会在这趟旅程中留下怎样的回忆？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
